title: CORE-3D: Context-aware Open-vocabulary Retrieval by Embeddings in 3D
abstract: arXiv:2509.24528v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Object retrieval from a scene has become a new trend of research due to its numerous applications. Recent approaches achieve zero-shot, open-vocabulary 3D semantic mapping by assigning embedding vectors to 2D class-agnostic masks generated via vision-language models (VLMs) and projecting these into 3D. However, these methods often produce fragmented masks and inaccurate semantic assignments due to the direct use of raw masks, limiting their effectiveness in complex environments. To address this, we leverage SemanticSAM with progressive granularity refinement to generate more accurate and numerous object-level masks, mitigating the over-segmentation commonly observed in mask generation models such as vanilla SAM, and improving downstream 3D semantic segmentation. translated_title: CORE-3D：基于三维嵌入的上下文感知开放词汇检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.24528v4 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：从场景中进行物体检索因其众多应用而成为研究的新趋势。近期方法通过将嵌入向量分配给由视觉语言模型（VLMs）生成的2D类别无关掩码，并将其投影到3D中，实现了零样本、开放词汇的3D语义映射。然而，这些方法由于直接使用原始掩码，常常产生碎片化的掩码和不准确的语义分配，限制了其在复杂环境中的有效性。为解决这一问题，我们利用具有渐进粒度细化的SemanticSAM来生成更准确且更丰富的对象级掩码，缓解了如原始SAM等掩码生成模型中常见的过度分割问题，并改善了后续的3D语义分割。为进一步增强语义上下文，我们采用了一种上下文感知的CLIP编码策略，该策略整合了每个掩码的多个上下文视图，并通过经验确定的方法进行优化。
tldr: 本文提出CORE-3D方法，通过利用SemanticSAM的渐进粒度细化生成更准确的3D对象掩码，并结合上下文感知的CLIP编码策略，显著提升了开放词汇3D物体检索的精度和鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CORE-3D, which leverages SemanticSAM with progressive granularity refinement to generate more accurate 3D object masks and employs a context-aware CLIP encoding strategy, significantly improving the accuracy and robustness of open-vocabulary 3D object retrieval.
